info.description:
- The graduation thesis provides opportunities for students to consolidate, review and synthesize the knowledge they have learned during their time at school.

- Provides students with the opportunity to apply their knowledge in the real world of  business. Promote the ability to think creatively, learn how to put the problem and solve the practical problems posed during the internship in the unit. Moreover, students can participate in the analysis, research and problem-solving related to the discipline.

- Create opportunities for students to compare and apply the knowledge and skills learned in practice. Graduation thesis helps students develop their ability to think critically in order to adapt to the continuous change of society and the ability to research in order to actively seek new ideas and lifelong learning.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Help students gain access to and apply the fundamentals of management, especially human resource management in solving business problems
Demonstrate ability to conduct research to identify and solve business problem critically and analytically
Demonstrate ability to read research paper in English and analyze data using popular software
Perform research to propose change and improve current issues about HRM in organization.
Propose the HRM solutions that consistent with business strategy in global context
State all the information properly according to the law, organizational regulation and policy
Demonstrate ability to propose positive changes to increase its business performance and support its strategy
Create challenge for students to perform effectively communication skills to get data and use the application of modern software and analytical tools.
Propose appropriate solution to motivate and develop human resource in the workplace through HRM system and process.
Educate students about responsibility as well as the attitudes to follow the professional codes of conducts, spirit and ability to learn throughout life
